parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four flaps (rotation lids) of a cardboard box, made of corrugated cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover that can be folded to close or open the box, protecting the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about the top edge of the box body, allowing it to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another flap of the cardboard box, made of the same material as the rest of the box.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in sealing the box when folded inward, providing structural closure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line at the top edge of the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation lid of the box, made of corrugated cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to the full closure of the box when all flaps are folded inward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its fold line, moving up and down to open or close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It completes the top closure of the box, overlapping with other flaps for secure sealing.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line, similar to the other lids.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the cardboard box, forming the container’s base and sides.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and holds the contents of the box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports the rotation lids.
